items.title: Educonomy
items.subtitle: Financial & Economic Awareness for Young Minds
items.headline: From the story of money to managing your own.
items.introStrapline: Building money confidence and economic awareness from an early age.
items.introDescription: Educonomy helps young minds understand money, choices and the world around them through simple, engaging lessons. It turns essential financial and economic ideas into practical knowledge children can use in everyday life.
items.imageAlt: A tree growing rupee coins above an open book and a stack of coins beside an Ikigyan money pouch.
items.shortDescription: A simple introduction to money, banking and smart financial habits for children.
items.fullDescription: Educonomy takes children beyond the basics of currency and introduces them to the world of money through stories, comics, activities and real-life situations.
items.closingLine: Learn it. See it. Try it. Make smarter choices.
